name: @repo/auth
//exports: No patch kind edits an exports map, so entries a feature module fills are declared here up front. './access' is filled by teams (src/access.ts, the permission vocabulary), './tenant' by multitenant (src/tenant.ts, requireTenant and the resolver table), './permissions' by multitenant (src/permissions.ts, requirePermission), './permission-rules' by teams (src/permission-rules.ts, the import-free can()), './caller' by api-keys-user (src/caller.ts, requireCaller and requireScope), and './phone' and './phone-rules' by auth-phone (src/phone.ts, the code sender and the path constants; src/phone-rules.ts, the import-free number rules). './permissions' and './caller' pull hono and the auth instance, so only './access', './permission-rules' and './phone-rules' are safe in a browser bundle; apps/admin imports can() from './permission-rules' to hide a control. Until each module is installed its subpath resolves to nothing and nothing imports it.
